steps.title: Unit tests
steps.body: `pnpm test` (4 packages at a time) or `pnpm --filter @velexis/db test`.

steps.title: Integration prerequisites
steps.body: PostgreSQL, Redis and Mailpit running; `TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL`, `REDIS_URL`, `MAILPIT_API_URL`, `SMTP_URL` in `.env.local`.

steps.title: Run
steps.body: `pnpm test:int` (one package at a time) or `pnpm --filter @velexis/testing test:int`.
steps.expect: A template `velexis_test_tpl_<runId>` built once, a clone per test file; your `velexis` database untouched.

steps.title: Check clean-up
steps.body: `psql "$TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL" -At -c "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname LIKE 'velexis\_test\_%'"`.
steps.expect: Empty after a run that ended normally.
